note.summary:
2.2 Customs, festivals and celebrations
Key focus
- traditions, family occasions, food, festivals and celebrations.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use past tense for previous celebrations, present tense for customs and future tense for planned events.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: भारत में दिवाली पर लोग घर सजाते हैं और परिवार के साथ मिठाइयाँ खाते हैं।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

In India, people decorate their homes at Diwali and eat sweets with family.

questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

My birthday is in April and every year I invite a few friends.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: ईद पर हमने नया भोजन बनाया और पड़ोसियों को मिठाई दी।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

At Eid we prepared special food and gave sweets to neighbours.

questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

At Holi, children wear colourful clothes and play with colours.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: अगले साल मैं दादा-दादी के साथ गाँव के मेले में भाग लूँगा।

Translate into Hindi:

Next year I will take part in the village fair with my grandparents.

questions.modelAnswer: मुझे पारंपरिक त्योहार पसंद हैं क्योंकि वे अलग-अलग पीढ़ियों को जोड़ते हैं।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I like traditional festivals because they connect different generations.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
भारत में दिवाली पर लोग घर सजाते हैं और परिवार के साथ मिठाइयाँ खाते हैं। मेरा जन्मदिन अप्रैल में है और हर साल मैं कुछ मित्रों को बुलाता हूँ। ईद पर हमने नया भोजन बनाया और पड़ोसियों को मिठाई दी। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: In India, people decorate their homes at Diwali and eat sweets with family. My birthday is in April and every year I invite a few friends. At Eid we prepared special food and gave sweets to neighbours. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
